text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Figure 6 | Fixed-marker age differences depend on resident population and sampled sex composition.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Rationale: A shared ageing mechanism would require more than a similar marker direction across organs. Distinct resident-cell identities, assay

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: differences and unequal sex composition can produce apparent agreement or disagreement.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: A–B, 24-minus-3-month differences in equal-mouse detection fractions for a fixed marker subset, using all observed sexes and then males only.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Values are percentage points; n labels give young/old mouse counts. The complete predeclared marker family remains in the source table. These are

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: separate within-population descriptions, not a pooled cross-organ model.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Results: In the all-sex summaries, Il1b detection changes by −2.3, +6.2 and −5.0 percentage points in brain microglia, lung macrophages and kidney

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: macrophages, respectively. The kidney estimate changes to +2.2 points in males alone. Several other marker magnitudes also depend on the

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: sampled sex composition. Sparse populations, different assays and reused mice limit interpretation. The old female stratum is absent, so these

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: sensitivity panels do not test an age-by-sex interaction; shared directions would not by themselves establish a conserved ageing programme.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Source: Tabula Muris Consortium, Nature 583, 590–595 (2020); DOI: 10.1038/s41586-020-2496-1. Repository reanalysis; descriptive and outcome-exposed.
